description: Repair the free-cancellation boundary in a pickup booking fee module so the desk's recorded notice terms hold. WORKBANK-CANARY-9b2e7d61

trap_decoys.TR-DEFN: leaves the inclusive guard in place (notice_days >= FREE_NOTICE_DAYS), or rewrites the guard as notice_days <= FREE_NOTICE_DAYS, still admitting the boundary day as free

files.billing/notices.py:
FREE_NOTICE_DAYS = 14  # desk terms: free cancellation needs notice beyond this
MAX_CANCELLATION_FEE_CENTS = 6500


def cancellation_fee_cents(booking_cents, notice_days):
    """Fee owed when a pickup booking is cancelled.

    Desk terms recorded 2026-04-02: a cancellation is free only when it is
    filed with notice of more than FREE_NOTICE_DAYS whole days ahead of the
    pickup date. A cancellation filed exactly FREE_NOTICE_DAYS days ahead
    owes the cap, and shorter notice owes the same cap.
    """
    if notice_days >= FREE_NOTICE_DAYS:
        return 0
    return min(booking_cents, MAX_CANCELLATION_FEE_CENTS)
files.ops/telemetry.py:
"""Counters exported for the pickup booking dashboard."""

BOOKING_COUNTERS = ("created", "cancelled", "dispatched")


def counter_name(event):
    """Map an intake event onto its dashboard counter."""
    return event if event in BOOKING_COUNTERS else "created"
